title: A honeymoon brass band story and changing funeral times and habits
summary: Zander recounts an airport honeymoon brass band. Rene notes funerals once held at 1 or 2 pm are now at any hour, and musicians' lives have changed.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line
